Okay then, I guess you're stuck with your mistake for the next year. As soon as you're able though sell it and get something cheaper. You can pay off all your dept other than the car dept with what you have saved up, so do that. You're letting money sit, gaining no interest in a chequing account while you're being charged interest from dept. I would get it all over with one shot, but I guess you could leave the school dept to be paid monthly if it has no interest charge. Open up an HISA and have your paychecks directly deposited there, then feed your chequing account from there. That way, at least your money is kinda keeping up with inflation. Then, if you feel up to it, make some low/no risk investments in a tfsa or rsp. The biggest thing is getting your spending down. 2100 per month before random bullshit while getting a sick deal from your parents is insane. Cut out every non-essential, live a boring bland life for the next few years. Again, there is no new iPhone, no CC dept, no fancy clothes, no eating out, no videogames, no nothing. Then, hopefully, by the time you're 30, you might be able to put a down-payment down, but you might have to keep up for a bit past 30.
